meta.title: Preprocessing Tree
meta.subtitle: From raw recordings to the inputs research uses (cohort 2026c)

trunks.title: Ephys (WILD neurologgers)
trunks.note: Two branches from the raw logger data: the LFP branch (sleep states, SWR, delta, theta) and the spike branch (Kilosort → units → place cells → replay).

trunks.title: Behaviour (video, WISER, IMU, mics)
trunks.note: Camera geometry and the sensors (WISER, head IMU, mics) feed identity and tracking, which feed the behaviour layer (labels, syllables, head direction).

nodes.title: Cross-day camera motion → frame corrections
nodes.done_when: A correction for every camera and cohort time needed (CH01-CH04 nights; CH05-CH08 all day), table rebuilt.
nodes.summary: Rigid-landmark tracking (the user's labels + automatic tracking) ties each cohort frame to a fixed reference frame. CH01-CH04: nights, hourly 21:00-04:20. CH05 / CH06 and CH07 / CH08: all day, segmented at the lid events. Table 1496 -> 2031 rows with the CH05 / CH06 day run. A daytime CH01-CH04 lookup still returns the nearest night sample (CH02 09-04 12:00: 30 px off); daytime corrections only if asked.
nodes.validation: Leave-one-out held-out landmark error. Night pass = median of the first three dawn closure frames <= 3 px; samples <= 3 / 6 px (CH01 / 02 / 05 / 06) and <= 5 / 10 px (CH03 / 04 / 07 / 08), both rules approved by the user; selftests pass. CH01 98 ok / 26 failed-night rows (incl. 09-09 rain), CH02 116 / 8; CH05 day held-out median 0.5 px, CH06 1.5 px.

nodes.title: Ultrasonic vocalisations (USV) from the house mics
nodes.done_when: A USV detector validated per mic against the user's labels and run on all files.
nodes.summary: DeepSqueak R1 batch gave false calls on the mics' steady 18-30 kHz tones, so whitened detectors were built. On the user's 260 labelled strips (36 with USV), thresholds chosen leave-one-window-out: v1 pooled 0.58 / 0.80 (sensitivity / specificity); v2 (20th-percentile background, contour linking, > 5-s line removal) MIC01 0.76 / 0.85 with precision 0.48, MIC02 <= 0.33. No per-mic rule adopted: precision too low. MIC01's drifting 18-21.5 kHz tone survives whitening. DINOv3 strip embeddings (Amendment 3, rule fixed before results): MIC01 AUC 0.88 vs v1 0.89 (at p >= 0.5: sensitivity 0.62, specificity 0.98, precision 0.87); MIC02 fails (AUC 0.12-0.35: its 15 positive strips lie in 3 windows). Not clearly better than v1, so by the rule: more labels first.
nodes.waiting_on_user: A second labelling round (proposed by the Mic session): about 24 new 5-min windows, 12 per mic, spread over 08-31 -> 09-10, night-weighted, presence only.
nodes.next: After the new labels: re-evaluate v1 / v2 / DINOv3 per mic; then a full run only for a mic that passes.

changes.what: blocked -> waiting_user: the Mic session is back; v2 detector and the DINOv3 strip classifier (Amendment 3) both not clearly better than v1 -> a second labelling round (commit 0e64f98).
